verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable feature-flag server, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a setting to disable Unleash's own telemetry or usage tracking. Edge keeping targeting PII local and self-hosting via Docker are adjacent privacy features, not an opt-out of telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
